abilities.title_en: Galvatron gains a Dark Energy Charge every {{var_1}} but quickly loses them while not Blocking.

abilities.title_en: If Galvatron reaches 30 Dark Energy Charges he will not lose the charges for {{var_2}}, after which he will lose them all.

abilities.desc_en: If Galvatron reaches 30 Dark Energy Charges he will not lose the charges for {{var_2}}, after which he will lose them all.

abilities.title_en: Each Dark Energy Charge increases the damage of Ranged Attacks by {{var_3}}.

abilities.desc_en: Each Dark Energy Charge increases the damage of Ranged Attacks by {{var_3}}.

abilities.desc_en: {{var_5}} chance for each Dark Energy Charge to inflict Dark Burn, instantly dealing {{var_6}} of Attack as Energy Damage.

abilities.desc_zh:
当敌人生命值较低时，惊破天有机会引导宇宙大帝自身的暗能量。

充满电时

对手每损失一定百分比的生命值，惊破天就有 {{var_9}} 几率变得不可阻挡，并获得 {{var_10}} 力量超过 {{var_11}}。

每级 +{{var_12}}
abilities.desc_en:
Will of Unicron
While the enemy is at low Health, Galvatron has a chance to channel dark energy from Unicron himself.
When Fully Charged
Galvatron has {{var_9}} chance for each percentage of the opponent’s missing Health to become Unstoppable and gain {{var_10}} Power over {{var_11}}.
+{{var_12}} per level

abilities.desc_zh: 惊破天使用他的粒子加速器向前跳跃并猛击他的对手。
abilities.desc_en: Particle Acceleration - Galvatron uses his Particle Accelerator to leap forward and bash his opponent.

abilities.desc_zh: 每个暗能量冲锋有 {{var_13}} 次机会击晕对手 {{var_14}}。 （充能 30 次时，击晕几率为 {{var_15}}。）
abilities.desc_en: {{var_13}} chance for each Dark Energy Charge to Stun the opponent for {{var_14}}. (At 30 charges, the chance to Stun is {{var_15}}.)

abilities.desc_en: Dark Energy Blast - Using vast stores of power, Galvatron fires a blast of super-charged particles.

abilities.desc_en: All Decepticon Special Attacks gain +{{var_27}}~{{var_28}} Special Attack Damage and +{{var_29}}~{{var_30}} Critical Damage.
